_readme: Continuous Editorial & Visual Learning Memory Bank. Ingests user ratings, negative exemplars, and visual/graphic guidelines to train topic, image, and graphic generation over time.

preferred_themes: Micro-scale mechanical physics and thermal fluidics
Sub-millimeter DFM tolerances and precision manufacturing
Metallurgical phase transformations and solid-state bonding
Deep-dive hardware teardowns with internal cross-sectional metrology
penalized_themes: Generic consumer product overviews without internal mechanics
Superficial specs without first-principles mathematical modeling

#005.title: How Vapor Chambers Flatten Die Hotspots
#005.subject: Thermal
#005.feedback: Praise for deep physical modeling, 0.35mm DFM tolerances, and 2-phase fluidics.

preferred_patterns: Topic-First, colon-separated architecture: '[Hardware Subject]: [Governing Physics / Failure Mode]'
Specific physical dimensions, load ratings, or metrics: e.g. '0.35 mm', '100g Shock Loads', '50-Bar'
Model headline after "Vapor Chambers: Two-Phase Planar Fluidics and Micro-Pillar DFM" (Topic-first engineering phrasing)
Compact Section Headings (<45 chars / 3-7 words): Keep sub-section titles concise so they render completely without truncation in the 240px Overview navigation rail
penalized_patterns: Vague consumer questions (e.g. 'Is It Really Worth It?')
Sensationalist buzzwords without mechanism name (e.g. 'The Insane Secret of...')
Generic software or brand comparisons (e.g. 'Company A vs Company B: Who Wins?')
Avoid headline structure like "Why Vapor Chambers Work": Original title was vague and lacked physical mechanisms
Overly verbose section titles (>50 chars) that get cut off in sidebar navigation rails

critiques.suggested_title: Vapor Chambers: Two-Phase Planar Fluidics and Micro-Pillar DFM
critiques.reason: Original title was vague and lacked physical mechanisms

prefer_real_photos_when: Cleaved, sliced, or peeled multi-layer hardware stacks showing authentic physical textures
Micro-scale sintered copper powder wicks, mesh weaves, and etched dimple/pillar arrays
Laboratory teardowns, wafer-level packaging cross-sections, and SEM micrographs
Micro-powder capillary wicking requires authentic macro teardown photography or SEM micrographs; simplified 2D vector schematics fail to convey physical pore diameter and sintered contact necks
prefer_generated_schematics_when: Abstract thermodynamic cycle state paths (P-h, T-s, P-v fluid phase diagrams)
Kinematic link angle diagrams, instantaneous center of rotation, and degree-of-freedom loops
Lumped thermal resistor circuit networks (R_th, junction-to-case) and vector force balances

format_critiques.reason: Vector line schematics oversimplify the micro-powder capillary wick texture and pillar array; authentic multi-layer teardown renders or photography provide superior physical understanding.
Micro-powder capillary wicking requires authentic macro teardown photography or SEM micrographs; simplified 2D vector schematics fail to convey physical pore diameter and sintered contact necks

positive_exemplars.reason: Authentic planar multi-layer exploded stack: top shell with die pad, perforated wick mesh, support pillars, bottom shell.
Real chemical-etched copper half-shells showing precision internal dimple and pillar arrays.

rejected_exemplars.title: GeForce RTX Graphics Card Shroud with Triple Fans
rejected_exemplars.reason: Exterior consumer product housing; hides the underlying vapor chamber and shows plastic fan shroud instead of internal mechanics.

rejected_exemplars.title: Laptop CPU Heat Pipe Cross Section (Round Flattened Tube)
rejected_exemplars.reason: 1D tubular pipe squashed flat; does not represent modern 2D planar stamped vapor chamber plates with internal pillar matrix.

rejected_exemplars.title: Amateur mobile phone hinge snapshot on wooden table
rejected_exemplars.reason: Old flip-phone knuckle joint on cluttered surface; lacks modern multi-link kinematic spine and precision studio lighting.

placement_rules: Hero image MUST be an authentic cleaved cross-section or teardown of the internal core mechanism, never exterior retail housing or fan shrouds.
Section figures must sit immediately adjacent to their corresponding physical equations or governing principles, not clustered at the end of the dispatch.
Never place an image before the introductory paragraph sets the physical problem context.
Never place a figure before its parent section's introductory text

mandatory_design_rules: Always use class='svg-canvas-bg' and class='svg-panel-bg' to inherit site theme CSS variables; never hardcode pitch-black or navy (#090D16, #0B132B) backgrounds.
All text labels must use font-family="'JetBrains Mono', monospace" with font-size >= 10.5px.
Flow vectors and leader lines must navigate open aisles; never cross through solid structural pillars, text boxes, or casing boundaries.
Maintain >= 30px breathing room between bottom plate geometry and lower viewport/legend boundaries.
